item.stem:
The diagram shows Alok's straight path through points $R$ and $S$. Arrowheads mark both ends, so the path continues forever past $R$ and forever past $S$.

What has he drawn?

options.A: A line segment $RS$, because $R$ and $S$ are the only points named.
options.B: A ray that starts at $R$ and stops at $S$.
options.C: A line through $R$ and $S$ that extends forever in both directions.
options.D: A ray, because any straight path with two named points must be a ray.
